gloss: which time (in a series); what number time

definitions.explanation: Asks for the ordinal position of an occasion — whether something is the second, third, fifth time, and so on. English has no single word for it, so it is usually translated with a full question.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{何回目|なんかいめ}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many times is this now?

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何回目|なんかいめ}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Is this your first time in Japan, or have you been before?

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}す→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{何回目|なんかいめ}だろう。
examples.english: I wonder how many times this makes that I have repeated the same mistake.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{何回|なんかい}→何回：08497_nankai⟧ (how many times) plus the ordinal suffix 〜⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧. The 〜⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ is what makes it ordinal: ⟦{何回|なんかい}→何回：08497_nankai⟧ asks for a total count, {何回目|なんかいめ} asks for a position in a series.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {何回目|なんかいめ}です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: which time is this?
- ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{何回目|なんかいめ}: how many times does this make
- {何回目|なんかいめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧: which attempt (in a series)

ANSWERING:
Answers use the same 〜⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ pattern: {一回目|いっかいめ} (the first time), {二回目|にかいめ} (the second time), {三回目|さんかいめ} (the third time).
